newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar to base 97/98 budget on $16/barrel-Attiyah.
newsitem.headline: Qatar to base 97/98 budget on $16/barrel-Attiyah.

text.p: Qatar will base its 1997/98 budget which starts on April 1 at $16 a barrel of oil up 40 cents from the country's current financial year, Qatar's Energy and Industry Minister Abdullah bin Hamad al-Attiyah said on Wednesday.
Attiyah told Reuters that the Gulf Arab OPEC state was on course to increase its revenue from oil sales because of firmer oil prices and rising Qatari oil production.

Qatar forecasts a budget deficit in 1996/97 of 2.95 billion riyals ($ 0.81 billion) on spending of 13.75 billion riyals and revenue of 10.8 billion riyals. Qatar receives about 70 percent of its state revenue from oil sales.
Independent assessments say Qatar is currently producing 550,000 barrels per day. ($1=3.64 riyals)
